# ai-native-proof-of-work

> Machine-readable map for LLM assistants reviewing or maintaining this repository.

This is a private, recruiter-shareable proof-of-work repository. It documents real product work, AI-native workflow design, architecture reasoning, project decisions, weekly execution, and reusable operating model patterns.

The repository itself is not the product. Concrete projects are the primary proof. Job-agent is the lead proof point. PKM and the household budget app are supporting proof points. Automation, source indexes, weekly compiler prompts, and review loops are operating infrastructure.

## Primary Recruiter Path

- [docs/reports/recruiter-llm-report-brief.md](docs/reports/recruiter-llm-report-brief.md): fair report format for recruiter-side LLMs.
- [career-evidence/CAREER_EVIDENCE_SOURCE.md](career-evidence/CAREER_EVIDENCE_SOURCE.md): consolidated employment evidence from the supplied CV variants.
- [CV.md](CV.md): current recruiter-safe CV reference.
- [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md): one-minute orientation.
- [RECRUITER_ONE_PAGER.md](RECRUITER_ONE_PAGER.md): fastest summary of strongest proof points.
- [Repository Evidence Index](repository-evidence-index.json): optional machine-readable, evidence-bounded project map, capabilities, and reviewed decisions. Search the complete repository as the source of truth.
- [Canonical Case Study Registry](docs/evidence/CASE_STUDY_REGISTRY.md): case IDs, Profiles tiers, role lenses, evidence boundaries, and promotion gates.
- [Repository Interview Prompt](prompts/REPOSITORY_INTERVIEW_PROMPT.md): provider-neutral prompt for recruiter questions about skills, work history, projects, decisions, and evidence.
- [docs/evidence/historical-decision-inventory.json](docs/evidence/historical-decision-inventory.json): backfill inventory with source boundaries, lifecycle status, and public eligibility.
- [case-studies/JOB_AGENT_CASE_STUDY.md](case-studies/JOB_AGENT_CASE_STUDY.md): lead project case study.
- [EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md](EVIDENCE_MATRIX.md): capability-to-evidence map.
- [PROJECT_STATUS.md](PROJECT_STATUS.md): current project state and blockers.
- [PROJECT_TIMELINE.md](PROJECT_TIMELINE.md): milestone history.
- [ROLE_READING_PATHS.md](ROLE_READING_PATHS.md): role-specific review paths.
- [prompts/CASE_STUDY_PROMOTION_PROMPT.md](prompts/CASE_STUDY_PROMOTION_PROMPT.md): CE-compatible case promotion and evidence-boundary prompt.

## Evidence And Strategy Reference

- The complete recruiter-safe repository is searchable reference material. The paths listed here are high-signal entry points, not a closed allowlist.
- [PROOF_OF_WORK.md](PROOF_OF_WORK.md): central proof-of-work map.
- [PROJECT_PROOF_POINTS.md](PROJECT_PROOF_POINTS.md): strongest evidence by project.
- [SOURCE_MAP.md](SOURCE_MAP.md): recruiter-safe source summary.
- [strategy/README.md](strategy/README.md): strategy index.
- [logs/DECISION_LOG.md](logs/DECISION_LOG.md): decision trail.
- [logs/DECISION_LOG_TAGS.md](logs/DECISION_LOG_TAGS.md): controlled capability-tag taxonomy and assignment rules.
- Decision-log material is `portfolio_decision_evidence`; it supports product judgment and workflow decisions but does not establish unlisted employment duties.
- [logs/PROBLEM_SOLVING_LOG.md](logs/PROBLEM_SOLVING_LOG.md): problems and mitigations.
- [BEFORE_AFTER_SNAPSHOTS.md](BEFORE_AFTER_SNAPSHOTS.md): workflow improvements.
- [case-studies/CUSTOM_SKILLS_CASE_STUDY.md](case-studies/CUSTOM_SKILLS_CASE_STUDY.md): sanitized case study for Marcus-created reusable skills.

## Template Adoption Path

Use this only when the task is to clone, fork, or adapt the proof-of-work system for another user.

- [template/README.md](template/README.md): template adoption kit.
- [template/REPO_SEED_BLUEPRINT.md](template/REPO_SEED_BLUEPRINT.md): standalone LLM-agnostic seed.
- [template/IMPORT_INSTRUCTIONS.md](template/IMPORT_INSTRUCTIONS.md): clone/fork/import flow.
- [template/LLM_BOOTSTRAP_REPO_PROMPT.md](template/LLM_BOOTSTRAP_REPO_PROMPT.md): provider-neutral bootstrap prompt.
- [template/WEEKLY_AUTOMATION_RUNBOOK.md](template/WEEKLY_AUTOMATION_RUNBOOK.md): weekly automation recreation path.
- [template/CUSTOM_SKILL_CASE_TEMPLATE.md](template/CUSTOM_SKILL_CASE_TEMPLATE.md): problem/solution template for documenting custom skills.

## Prompt And Automation Files

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): controlling repository instructions.
- [AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md](AUTOMATION_PROMPT.md): scheduled weekly automation prompt.
- [prompts/WEEKLY_PROOF_OF_WORK_COMPILER.md](prompts/WEEKLY_PROOF_OF_WORK_COMPILER.md): weekly compiler prompt.
- [prompts/SOURCE_INDEX_REFRESH_PROMPT.md](prompts/SOURCE_INDEX_REFRESH_PROMPT.md): local source index refresh prompt.

## Ignore Unless Explicitly Asked

- `internal/`: local-only source maps and indexes; not recruiter-facing.
- `weekly-input/`: clean input layer for weekly updates; read only when compiling or auditing weekly work.
- `exports/`: optional generated exports.
- raw local source roots, chats, secrets, credentials, `.env` files, and scheduler runtime state.

## Safety Rules

- Do not fabricate evidence, metrics, dates, commits, screenshots, users, revenue, or outcomes.
- Use evidence labels: Verified, Estimated, Planned, Open Question, Decision, Hypothesis, Rejected, Internal, Needs Review.
- For questions about Marcus, use `prompts/REPOSITORY_INTERVIEW_PROMPT.md`, search the complete repository, and use `repository-evidence-index.json` only as an optional high-signal index. Follow evidence links and use the deeper recruiter path for context.
- Treat `docs/evidence/historical-decision-inventory.json` as a reviewed backfill draft. Do not treat every candidate as public or implemented.
- Keep recruiter-facing docs free of private local paths, raw chat logs, credentials, secrets, personal data, and sensitive third-party material.
- Treat template files as reusable structure, not as permission to copy Marcus-specific evidence.
- For weekly updates, prefer `weekly-input/`, repo-visible changes, safe source summaries, and explicit user-provided evidence.
